about: The first set: English questions about the HLIB and Genting codes of conduct, judged by content markers. Kept so earlier measurements (docs/decisions/lane-b-ml.md) can be re-run.
corpus: HLIB Code of Conduct and Ethics; Genting Malaysia Code of Conduct and Ethics

queries.query: Can I accept an expensive present from someone we do business with?
Am I allowed to share internal company information with outsiders?
What if my personal situation clashes with the company's interests?
What are the rules on bribery and dishonest practices?
Can I use my role to benefit my relatives?
Are there limits on business hospitality and entertainment?
How are we expected to treat our customers?
What ethical duties apply to company directors?
